svg.aria-label: Crypto Tweet Impact — A statistically rigorous data-science pipeline and event study that evaluates the market impact of ~20,000 LLM-classified tweets on Bitcoin and Dogecoin prices using multiple-testing corrections and an interactive Shiny dashboard.
